name: Free disk space
plain: Exact free disk space is hidden; a fuzzy quota estimate leaks.
meaning: navigator.storage.estimate().quota is about 60% of disk in Chrome and Safari 17, with noise. Exact free space and total disk size are not exposed; quota gives bits of a size class (256 GB vs 512 GB vs 1 TB).

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

fields.name: proxy: storage.estimate quota
fields.range: tens to thousands of GB, approx 60% of disk, bucketed in private mode

fields.name: proxy: usage
fields.range: bytes used by this origin only

limits.headline: Can't see exact free disk space, only a fuzzy storage quota
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when a page checks how much it can store
can: See a storage quota, about 60% of disk in Chrome and Safari 17
See how much the site has already used
Guess a disk size class, like 256 GB, 512 GB, or 1 TB
cannot: Get a clean number; noise is added

story.what_it_is: Exact free disk space is hidden, but a fuzzy storage figure still leaks a rough size.

marketing.name: Storage for the web
marketing.pitch: web.dev explains the storage figure sites get, which is a rough budget rather than free space.

story.for_you: Sites cannot see how full your disk is. They get a rough budget for their own storage. That budget can still hint at how large your disk is.
story.for_makers: Free space and exact disk size would be a valuable clue about a device. The web gives a rough quota instead. Apps use the quota to plan offline downloads.

use_cases.example: A browser game wanted exact free space to plan big downloads and uses the quota.
A streaming site wanted free space before offline downloads and checks quota too.
An offline notes app wanted to avoid a full disk and handles failed saves gracefully.
A fraud team wanted disk size to spot virtual machines and uses the quota.
An advertiser wanted disk size as a wealth signal and gets only the fuzzy quota.
A browser editor wanted exact space for big projects and asks before caching.
A cleanup site wanted to show how full your disk is and cannot.

risks: Quota still hints at disk size

legit_uses: None: the browser deliberately withholds it
abuse: Sites attempt proxies to recover it
